case_name: Smt Deepa P vs Sri A Lokesh
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife seeking transfer of matrimonial proceedings in MC No.45/2021 to the Court of VI Addl. Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru to be tried along with pending MC No.3553/2022 filed by the petitioner.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking transfer of proceedings must demonstrate a reasonable apprehension of danger to their life.
legal_principles.held: It is the case of the petitioner that she has taken shelter under her parents at Bengaluru and staying with them and prosecuting the case filed by her. Since the petitioner is residing presently at Bengaluru, it would be difficult for her to travel from Bengaluru to Channapatna to attend the proceedings in the Family Court, which would involve costs for stay, accommodation and food and the distance between two places is approximately 80 kms.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking transfer of proceedings must demonstrate that the transfer would be in the interests of justice.
legal_principles.held: In view of this, learned counsel for petitioner contends that if the matter is transferred to Bengaluru, where the petitioner is residing, it will be easy for her to attend to the case and she would not have to incur much expenditure and avoid threat to her life.
